title: Emberfall Warden
premise: A lantern-bearing warden crosses a dimming keep to relight its heart-forge, trading sparks with the rust creatures that snuffed it.
core_loop: Explore a room and fight or avoid rust creatures
Collect sparks and gear from fallen enemies and caches
Spend sparks with the hermit to open the path onward
Reach the heart-forge, defeat its warden, and relight it
win_condition: The heart-forge boss is defeated and the forge is relit.
lose_condition: Hero hp reaches 0 with no checkpoint spark remaining.

controls: arrow keys: move in four directions
c: open and close the inventory
abilities: lantern swing: 1 damage in a short frontal arc, 0.4s cooldown
spark dash: brief burst of speed, unlocked by the hermit's quest

entities.name: rust_stalker
entities.description: A low, four-legged clot of corroded plate that hunts by lantern light.

entities.name: forge_warden
entities.description: The boss: a furnace golem whose chest vents glow before each slam.

entities.name: hermit
entities.description: A soot-robed keeper who trades sparks for passage and gives the quest.

systems.description: Four-directional hero movement with wall collision inside each 1024x576 room.
acceptance: Holding an arrow key moves the hero at a constant speed in that direction
The hero never passes through a wall rect or leaves the playfield
Releasing all keys stops the hero within one frame

systems.description: Always-visible hp, spark count, and quest hint line on a CanvasLayer.
acceptance: The HUD shows current hp, spark count, and active quest hint every frame
HUD values change in the same frame as the underlying state

systems.description: Lantern-swing melee with damage, knockback, hit cooldown, and hero death.
acceptance: A swing damages every enemy inside the frontal arc exactly once
Enemy contact costs the hero 1 hp and grants 1.0s of invulnerability
Hero hp never drops below 0 and death triggers the lose flow

systems.description: rust_stalker state machine: patrol waypoints, chase on sight, attack in range, staggered on hit.
acceptance: A stalker outside detection radius follows its patrol route
A stalker inside detection radius chases the hero and attacks in range
A hit stalker enters staggered for 0.5s and cannot deal damage during it

systems.description: Sparks and gear pickups collect into a c-key inventory panel.
acceptance: Walking over a pickup removes it from the room and adds it to the inventory
The inventory panel lists every held item and the exact spark count
Spending sparks reduces the count and never goes negative

systems.description: x-key dialogue with the hermit, advancing line by line with a visible speaker name.
acceptance: Pressing x next to the hermit opens dialogue and freezes hero movement
Each x press advances one line; the final press closes the dialogue and unfreezes the hero

systems.description: One quest: the hermit asks for 10 sparks, then unlocks spark dash and the forge door.
acceptance: The quest stage advances only when 10 sparks are handed to the hermit
Completing the quest unlocks spark dash and opens the forge door
The HUD hint reflects the current quest stage

systems.description: Three connected rooms with edge exits; enemies and pickups persist per room.
acceptance: Walking through an exit loads the adjacent room and places the hero at the matching entrance
A cleared room stays cleared when revisited

systems.description: forge_warden two-phase fight gated behind the quest-opened door.
acceptance: The boss telegraphs every slam with a vent glow before dealing damage
At half hp the boss enters enraged and its attack cadence increases
Defeating the boss relights the forge and triggers the win flow

systems.description: Checkpoint save at room entry; load restores the full declared save_state.
acceptance: Entering a room writes a checkpoint containing every field in save_state
Loading after a death restores position, hp, inventory, and quest stage exactly
Loading never duplicates already-collected pickups
